The '''Gree Repair Sphere''' was an example of technology used by the inhabitants of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]]. This element of [[Gree technology]] were strange devices that were referred to by their [[Gree (species)/Legends|users]] as ''"tool-sphere repair-mothers"'' that were capable of repairing damage done to power conduits.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], one such piece of equipment was used to restore the power conduits within [[The Works/Legends|The Works]] after [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was [[Sacking of Coruscant|invaded]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
